proposal.utterance: Classify 'agent connectedness' as a kind of entity.

entities.label: AgentConnectedness
entities.rationale: Agent connectedness is a property that inheres in agents (or collections of agents) — it characterizes how connected an agent is within a relational network. As a measurable, bearer-specific property it fits BFO Quality (BFO_0000019). It is not a disposition (no triggering condition for manifestation), not a role (not externally grounded in a social function), and not a process (it is not an occurrent). Typing as Quality is the most defensible conservative choice, pending clarification from the user.

relations.rationale: AgentConnectedness is proposed as a subclass of BFO Quality (BFO_0000019), expressing that any instance of agent connectedness is a quality inhering in some bearer agent or agent collective.

open_questions: Is 'agent connectedness' a graded, measurable property of a single agent (favoring Quality), or is it constituted by a set of relations between agents that no single agent bears alone? If the latter, a generically dependent continuant (pattern/structure) or a relational quality might be more appropriate.

Should the bearer of agent connectedness be a single individual agent, a social group, or a legal institution? This affects whether it inheres in a material entity (person, organization) or a more abstract collective.

Is agent connectedness something that can be acquired and lost over time (i.e., a time-indexed quality), or is it a stable structural feature of a network? If the latter, consider subclassing working:RelationalCoherence or working:StructurallyGroundedIdentity instead.
Is this concept intended to connect to the existing working:RelationalDependencyNetwork or working:NetworkNode classes already in the ontology?
proposal.rationale_summary: The phrase 'agent connectedness' most naturally denotes a property — specifically, how connected an agent is within some relational structure. In BFO 2020, such a bearer-specific, intrinsic-or-relational property belongs under Quality (BFO_0000019), which covers measurable properties that inhere in exactly one bearer at a time. It is distinguished from Disposition (BFO_0000016) because agent connectedness does not require a triggering process for manifestation, and from Role (BFO_0000023) because it is not externally grounded in a social or institutional context (though this could change with clarification). It is not an occurrent. The proposal is conservative: a new class AgentConnectedness is minted as a subclass of BFO Quality. Several open questions are raised because the exact nature of the bearer and whether the concept is genuinely monadic or irreducibly relational could shift the typing toward, e.g., a generically dependent continuant encoding a network pattern, or a relational quality subclassing an existing working class such as RelationalCoherence.
